# External public source repository

The original COCOMO analysis repository is not copied into this repository.
Retrieve it with:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/neogilab/Immunometabolism_HIV.git external/Immunometabolism_HIV
```

The source repository is public and is licensed under Apache-2.0. The present
study uses the Olink, metabolomics, clinical/processing resources needed by the
reproducibility scripts. Do not modify the source clone when reproducing the
analysis; keep study-specific code in this repository.
